title: Late-filing penalties
text: Clause 1. A company that fails to file its annual return or financial statements within the prescribed period shall pay an additional fee of five hundred rupees for every day of delay, subject to a maximum of five lakh rupees, in place of the existing fixed fee.

title: Beneficial ownership disclosure
text: Clause 2. Every person who holds, directly or indirectly, ten per cent or more of the shares or voting rights of a company shall be disclosed to the Registrar within thirty days, and the particulars shall be entered in a register open to public inspection.

title: Audit requirement for small companies
text: Clause 3. The exemption from statutory audit currently available to small companies is withdrawn, and every company shall have its annual accounts audited by a practising chartered accountant irrespective of turnover or paid-up capital.

title: Incorporation timelines
text: Clause 4. The Registrar shall dispose of an application for incorporation within seven working days of receipt, and an application that is complete and not decided within that period shall be deemed approved.

title: Liability of non-executive directors
text: Clause 5. A non-executive or independent director shall be liable for a contravention of this Act only if it occurred with his knowledge, attributable through board processes, or with his consent or connivance, or where he failed to act diligently.

title: Mandatory electronic filing
text: Clause 6. All filings, returns and notices under this Act shall be made in electronic form on the designated portal, and acceptance of physical filings at Registrar offices shall be discontinued after a transition period of one year.
